_comment: Hand corrections applied AFTER classification, keyed by blog key.
Every entry here was found by auditing the classifier's output against
sibling domains it labelled differently. The source field is the one that
matters most: it decides whether a blog is hidden behind the newsroom
toggle, and it is inherited by every post the blog published.
_deny_comment: Hosting, social and paste domains the classifier labelled as blogs rather
than skipping. plus.google.com alone carried 437 stories from many unrelated
authors, which is the buttondown.email failure in a different costume.

Status pages and release-note firehoses: their feeds emit one entry per datacenter per day, which floods the Newest view. Note this cannot be a regex on 'status|changelog' -- changelog.complete.org is John Goerzen's blog and electronupdate.blogspot.com is real teardowns.

Code forges and single-page tools publish no posts: code.ffmpeg.org's stories are a commit, a repo and an issue (the bug-tracker entries above), and dogbolt.org's three are the same decompiler tool. The 2026-09 labelling pass admitted both while judging binvis.io, the same kind of tool, out.
